title: The passive scanner: core to the pscan add-on
description: How the passive scanner engine is recorded in the zaproxy and zap-extensions histories: a core extension from 2011, and the pscan add-on from 2024. The scan rules are in a separate story.

chapters.title: Passive scanning in core, 2011
chapters.text: The commit "Perform passive scanning in a background thread and introduce some passive vulnerability scanners" is dated 2011-01-03 and adds org/zaproxy/zap/extension/pscan/PassiveScanThread.java, PassiveScanner.java and PassiveScannerList.java.

chapters.title: Scanners added and removed dynamically, 2014
chapters.text: On 2014-03-23 zaproxy has "Issue 1086 - Allow to dynamically add/remove passive scanners".

chapters.title: 2024: the pscan add-on begins
chapters.text: On 2024-06-25 zaproxy has "Deprecate and disable pscan API", whose message says the API will be provided by the add-on and adds pscan to the weekly add-ons, as part of zaproxy issue 7959. The same day zap-extensions has "pscan: migrate core API implementor", the earliest commit touching addOns/pscan.

chapters.title: Core passive scanner deprecated and disabled
chapters.text: On 2024-11-18 zaproxy has "Deprecate unused passive scan methods" and "Deprecate/remove passive scan related options"; the latter's message says the options and UI will be managed by the pscan add-on. On 2024-12-03 "Deprecate/disable core passive scanner" says the passive scanner is no longer added or used because the pscan add-on will do it, and that the extension itself is not yet deprecated because other core extensions still use it.

chapters.title: Statistics move, and the state at HEAD
chapters.text: On 2025-12-04 zaproxy has "Remove pscan alerts statistics (migrating to add-on)". The pscan add-on's changelog lists 0.6.0 dated 2025-12-15 with "Migrate handling of Alerts raised statistics from the core." At HEAD, zaproxy still contains zap/src/main/java/org/zaproxy/zap/extension/pscan/ExtensionPassiveScan.java, and zap-extensions contains addOns/pscan, addOns/pscanrules, addOns/pscanrulesBeta and addOns/pscanrulesAlpha.
